shared: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one original square 1:1 digital New Year print creation-canvas background for the HarmonyOS app 朱仙镇年画. Scene: {SCENE} Style: premium modern guochao anime-inflected illustration with confident woodblock outlines, subtle overprinted mineral-pigment edges and visible handmade paper or material texture. Brand family cinnabar #A52C32, gold #D6A64D, rice-paper #F7EEDB, jade #527E70; theme-appropriate accents permitted. Compose real thematic detail mostly around the outer 20 percent; central 60 percent remains usable for user-added character and text layers, with interesting tactile material instead of a flat placeholder. This is a modern original design, not a reproduction of a historical relic. No lettering, calligraphy, digits, logos, watermark, UI controls, photorealistic people or repeated stock icons. Full opaque background.
specs: Warm handmade ivory xuan paper with a carefully drawn vermilion plum branch sweeping along one upper corner and a few fallen petals near the lower edge. Quiet, delicate, tactile ink edges.
A cinnabar red woodblock ground with elegant gold-and-ivory auspicious cloud bands framing the top and bottom, richly detailed carved lines, center intentionally calmer and lighter red.
Muted jade green paper with ivory ruyi-shaped scrolling corner ornaments and discreet golden accents, elegant asymmetrical border with generous center space.
Coral and cinnabar peony blossoms with deep jade leaves at two opposing corners, buttery ivory central paper, carefully layered rounded petals in refined guochao anime illustration.
A playful pair of goldfish among pink lotus blooms and blue-green leaves around the bottom edge of an ivory pond-like paper composition, airy ripples; upper and central area spacious.
A dark green pine branch at the top edge and a graceful white crane with vermilion crown standing at the lower corner, warm pale sky and cloud texture, quiet poetic woodblock illustration.

Deep indigo evening paper with several warm cinnabar lanterns suspended around the upper corners and small golden light motes along the outer edge, calm luminous center, sophisticated festive night mood.
Layered jade mountains and cream cloud swirls rising from the lower border, warm rice paper sky above, bold woodcut contours, modern refined Chinese landscape illustration.
Original red paper-cut lattice and floral window-frame border on warm ivory paper, clear central rectangular opening, crisp tactile layered-paper edges and delicate symmetrical folk-art details.
Warm amber pearwood texture with carefully carved floral grooves limited to the outer frame, gently lit wood grain at the center, tactile premium printing-block surface, no tools or characters.
Elegant gold and jade water-wave bands curving along the bottom and side borders on soft cream paper, wave details like carved woodblock strokes, spacious calm center.
Cobalt blue and ivory ceramic-inspired scrolling lotus border over subtly textured warm paper, clear central area, delicate hand-painted indigo contours and restrained gold details.
Pale warm sky with two original swallow-shaped and butterfly-shaped traditional kites near upper corners, fine flowing strings and soft cloud wisps along outer edges, center uncluttered.
Soft blush ivory paper framed by two peach blossom branches with red buds and jade leaves, delicate petal movement, modern anime color shading mixed with woodblock line texture.

An original circular border of twelve tiny friendly Chinese zodiac animal silhouettes as carved folk-art motifs, each distinct animal once, cinnabar gold jade accents around a large blank ivory central disc. No labels or writing.
Handwoven vermilion Chinese decorative knots and jade tassels arranged along the outer side borders, cream paper center, intricate but clear braided cord illustration, warm celebratory mood.

Warm handmade paper with expressive charcoal ink-brush sweeps limited to two corners, fine flecks of cinnabar mineral pigment and subtle gold leaf around the edges, open luminous central area; genuine material depth.
Fan-shaped golden ginkgo leaves with warm amber stems layered along one side and the bottom edge, ivory rice paper center, elegant hand-printed texture and clear leaf vein details.
A ripe open pomegranate and leafy branch at one lower corner, ruby seeds clearly drawn, small complementary flowers along the far upper edge, warm paper center and restrained jade-and-gold accents.
Rounded ripe pink peaches with dark jade leaves resting above soft golden cloud curls along the bottom edge, pale cream background and a gentle distant mountain hint, spacious creative center.
